fields.description:
Cut the recurring CI cost of obtaining the tickets branch by applying a blobless partial clone at the three actions/checkout@v7 entry points. Measured baseline from session_log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4: full checkout 1.04 GiB / 59 s wall / 319 s CPU; blob:none 68.7 MiB / 14.3 s. Do not re-derive those historical measurements.

## Scope and mechanism
The recurring reconcile, standalone identity, and canary workflows use actions/checkout with fetch-depth: 0, which fetches all branches. Therefore the 1.04 GiB tickets history arrives during checkout, before the later manual tickets fetch. Add filter: blob:none to actions/checkout in:
- .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml
- .github/workflows/verify-identity.yml
- .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge-canary.yml

The subsequent plain git fetch origin +tickets refspec must inherit the named remote partial-clone filter. A config-presence assertion is insufficient because Git records partialclonefilter even when a server ignores it. The non-vacuous oracle is a real Git server with uploadpack.allowFilter=true: a named origin is first configured blobless, a previously absent tickets ref containing a known blob is then fetched with no explicit --filter, GIT_TRACE_PACKET must show fetch> filter blob:none, and the known blob must remain missing until worktree materialization.

The two direct-URL tickets fetches in .github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml are acknowledged but intentionally excluded: they do not use actions/checkout or a named origin, so the inheritance mechanism in this ticket cannot reach them; adding --filter directly has different promisor/lazy-fetch safety requirements. Track that distinct seam as discovered follow-up work rather than silently broadening this change.

## Safety and observability
Never use filter: tree:0 here: it measured 3.57 GiB across 2,255 promisor packs, 3.4x larger than full. The action filter input may coexist with sparse checkout; none of the three target steps uses sparse checkout.

git worktree add is safe after the blobless fetch because it uses the unpack-trees -u/check_updates path, which batch-prefetches missing promisor blobs. This differs from the read-tree plus checkout-index path documented in tests/unit/test_snapshot_blobless_747f.py, which can lazy-fetch one blob per RPC. A held-out real-Git test must prove materialization plus a diverged remote reconvergence completes, with the tickets files present and the merged local event retained.

Add a checkout measurement step immediately after actions/checkout in the standalone verify-identity workflow. Parse size-pack from git count-objects -v and fail above 102400 KiB (100 MiB). The threshold is deliberately above the measured 68.7 MiB while still requiring at least a 90 percent reduction from the 1.04 GiB baseline; this detects a server that ignores the filter.

Wrap whole-store rebar verify-identity with exact before/after git count-objects -v snapshots taken after tickets worktree materialization. Fail if they differ. Worktree materialization is allowed to fetch current-tree blobs; the identity scan itself must add no loose objects or packs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Each of the three target actions/checkout@v7 steps sets filter: blob:none while retaining fetch-depth: 0 and existing credential/ref settings. Tier: parsed workflow contract. Proving command: pytest tests/unit/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone_workflows.py -v.
- [ ] The standalone verify-identity checkout records git count-objects -v immediately after checkout and fails when size-pack exceeds 102400 KiB. This is compared with the recorded 1.04 GiB full baseline and detects server-side filter refusal; a config-only check is forbidden. Tier: CI job measurement plus parsed workflow contract. Proving command: pytest tests/unit/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone_workflows.py -k size_pack -v.
- [ ] A plain manual tickets fetch from a named blobless origin inherits the filter: GIT_TRACE_PACKET contains fetch> filter blob:none and a known tickets blob remains absent before worktree materialization. Tier: real temporary Git server/repository. Proving command: pytest tests/integration/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone.py -k inherits_filter -v.
- [ ] A blobless runner materializes the tickets worktree and reconverges a locally diverged tickets branch against a remote update using the configured ours merge driver; all expected events remain reachable and the final push succeeds. Tier: real-Git end to end. Proving command: pytest tests/integration/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone.py -k reconverges -v.
- [ ] Whole-store verify-identity on the blobless runner triggers no promisor fetch: exact git count-objects -v output is identical immediately before and after rebar verify-identity, and the workflow fails on any difference. Tier: CI job measurement plus real-Git integration. Proving commands: pytest tests/unit/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone_workflows.py -k no_promisor -v and pytest tests/integration/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone.py -k verify_identity -v.

## Files
.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml; .github/workflows/verify-identity.yml; .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge-canary.yml; tests/unit/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone_workflows.py; tests/integration/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone.py.

Scope: S-M. Depends on closed B3 040e-3f0c-ae86-4212 and closed B6 3036-cb14-86b5-44a3.
